targets.query: from(bucket: "fitness") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "daily_summary" and r._field == "steps") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "fitness") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "daily_summary" and r._field == "resting_hr") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "fitness") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "daily_summary" and r._field == "distance_m") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
from(bucket: "fitness") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "activity")
